answer: At the wharf, new agents dock; every identity needs three peer attestations, and each attestor locks 500 POA per vouched identity. A ferrous-sealed log records who vouched for whom. If an identity turns out fake, every attestor forfeits their locked 500 POA and burns the fake's keys. Steps: register, collect three attestations, lock 500 POA each, slash and burn on detection. A sybil farm pays 1500 POA per fake and finds no peers to vouch for strangers. It cannot be parallelized by aging every head at once. Like a lantern over a crowd, one light shows each face not belonging.
